1.title: Choose
1.body: An amount, a design and a message that sounds like you.

2.title: We deliver
2.body: An elegant email with the card and its code, now or on the day you pick.

3.title: They sparkle
3.body: They enter the code at checkout and spend it in one or several orders.

1.a: {{months}} months from the delivery date. The remaining balance is always shown at checkout.

2.q: Can it be used in several orders?
2.a: Yes. Whatever isn’t spent stays on the card for the next order.

3.q: What can it be spent on?
3.a: Eligible gems, kits, aftercare and trainings. It can’t be used to buy another gift card.

4.q: What if the email doesn’t arrive?
4.a: Check the spam folder, then contact us — we can resend it to the right address in minutes.
